The former [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] owned a '''private estate''' on [[Surtsey]], an island on the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While the outer gardens were vast and lavish, Mothma's dwelling itself was modest. A low and squarish house, it only contained three rooms, all of which had transparent walls and ceilings.
